tagline: IPTV player for Android TV, Fire TV and mobile
_ad_slot: In-article unit id. The head loader ships on every page whatever this says; this only controls the two hand-placed units inside an article. Leave it empty until the account is approved, because the id does not exist before then and an empty one is broken ad code. Paste it here, run python build.py.
_cse_id: Hosted search engine id. Empty means no search field, no /search/ page and no footer search link are written. After changing it, run python build.py.
disclaimer: InoxTV does not provide any sources of TV channels. To watch TV channels, add a playlist provided by your own IPTV service.

default.heading: Something wrong on this page?
default.sub: A step that no longer matches the app, a label renamed in a later build, a setting that behaves differently on your device.

search.heading: Search not finding it?
search.sub: A phrase someone would reasonably type that turns up nothing useful here, or a result that answers a different question than the one you asked.

guides.title: Setup guides
guides.description: Step-by-step setup guides for InoxTV on Android TV, Fire TV Stick and Android phones: installing the app, adding a playlist, and getting the TV guide working.
guides.lede: Work through these in order the first time. Each guide is written for one device and one task, and says exactly which on-screen labels to look for.

features.title: Features
features.description: What each InoxTV feature does, where to find it, and how it behaves differently on Android TV and on a phone. Written from the app's own settings screens.
features.lede: One page per feature. Each one names the exact settings path, lists every option value, and ends with the problems people actually hit.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.description: Fixes for the problems InoxTV users report most: buffering, a playlist that will not load, missing TV guide data, a channel that will not play, no sound, and login errors.
troubleshooting.lede: Find your symptom, not your theory about the cause. Each page starts with the fix that solves it most often and works down from there.

remote.title: Remote key reference
remote.description: Complete InoxTV key maps: every remote button in the player, the TV guide and the movies and shows screens, its default action, and every action you can reassign it to.
remote.lede: These tables are generated from the app's own key definitions, so they match the defaults your build actually ships with.
